stats.title: The Crisis in Verified Numbers
stats.subtitle: The challenge is not a lack of attractions, but extreme concentration in the south while 6 recipient regencies remain under-visited.

stat1.label: Concentration in South Bali
stat1.desc: Over 80% of direct tourism visits stay packed within Badung & Denpasar corridors.

stat2.label: Average Waiting Time
stat2.desc: Hours lost queuing for a 3-minute photo at viral gates, creating gridlocks.

stat3.label: Tax Revenue Imbalance
stat3.desc: Badung absorbs nearly half of all regional taxes, while Bangli's hotel tax is just 0.12% despite having 43 official attractions.

stat4.label: Untapped Economic Potential
stat4.desc: Estimated annual spending uncaptured in northern and eastern MSME corridors.

stats.sourceNote: Sources: BPS Bali (2024–2025), DJPK Ministry of Finance, Bank Indonesia Representative Office Bali.

agents.title: 3 Specialized Agents. 1 Calmer Bali.
agents.subtitle: An autonomous multi-agent pipeline working in seconds to deconstruct aesthetics, forecast crowd dynamics, and generate ethical diversions.

agent1.name: Vibe Deconstructor
agent1.desc: Breaks down photo scenery into 5 sensory dimensions: topography, architecture, lighting, activity, and visual density to find true aesthetic twins.

agent2.name: Crowd Telemetry & CFS
agent2.desc: Computes Congestion Forecast Scores (CFS) across live footfall, 7x24 weekly forecasts, and simulation heuristics to identify calm windows.

agent3.name: Rerouting & MSME Bundler
agent3.desc: Generates micro and regional diversions, pairings with certified local food/artisan MSMEs, and sacred Balinese etiquette guidance.

impact.title: Moving Tourists, Not Just Budget Transfers
impact.subtitle: Administrative transfers of 10% PHR only shift paper budgets. Margi AI physically redistributes purchasing power directly to grassroots communities.
impact.pillar1Desc: Instant relief for on-the-go travelers trapped in Ubud or Canggu traffic jams, redirecting to tranquil sanctuaries around the corner.
impact.pillar2Desc: Connecting visitors to 6 recipient regencies (Karangasem, Buleleng, Tabanan, Bangli, Klungkung, Jembrana) with equivalent aesthetic grandeur.
impact.pillar3Desc: Direct footfall redirection to family-owned warungs, organic farmers, and heritage craft artisans with zero platform commission.

responsible.title: Engineered with Reverence for Bali's Sacred Heritage
responsible.privacyDesc: Guest images are processed in-memory and discarded immediately. EXIF geo-data is stripped on the client side with no facial recognition.
responsible.cultureDesc: Every temple diversion includes verified adat guidelines: sarong & sash requirements, sacred boundaries, and respectful conduct rules.
responsible.glassBoxDesc: Every step, model call, and fallback tier is streamed live in the transparent terminal Thought Stream for total judge accountability.
